title: Customer, admin, session ve onboarding kullanici akislarini dogrula

operations.description: Customer login formunun password, magic-link ve password reset submitlerinin ilgili route ve payload ile birebir eslestigini kontrol et.
Admin login formunun password, magic-link ve reset akisini allowlist route gate'iyle eslestir; allowlist disi email icin 403 sozlesmesini kontrol et.
Auth callback code ve fragment yollarinda session exchange, user lookup, redirect sanitization ve dashboard/onboarding hedeflerini kontrol et.
Dashboard server auth'in unauthenticated, no membership, no dietitian ve inactive entitlement dallarini expected redirect/gate ile karsilastir.
Onboarding status, password creation ve claim endpointlerini session_id/invite_id ambiguity, expired/claimed/missing reference ve success redirect ile kontrol et.
Logout, recovery ve auth-not-configured davranislarinin hassas veri sizdirmadan stable error/redirect verdigini kontrol et.
Demo/fallback gate'inin local-only oldugunu source ve environment matrix ile kanitla.
Auth ve onboarding hedef test gruplarini calistir; her akisin browser ile 5.4 yerel backend smoke adimina hazir oldugunu kaydet.

rules: all auth forms map to live route handlers
